programme.title: Authentic Escapes
programme.desc: In this unforgettable episode of Authentic Escapes, Sandra McLemore uncovers the heart of Istanbul—a city where East meets West, and ancient tradition blends seamlessly with modern life. From the vibrant Spice Bazaar filled with Turkish delight and tea, to Michelin-starred Ottoman cuisine that revives centuries-old royal recipes, Sandra dives deep into the flavors and culture of this mesmerizing destination. She explores the mysterious Basilica Cistern, a hidden underground marvel, and reveals the artistry behind handwoven Turkish carpets—each a story told in knots and color. With practical travel tips, immersive storytelling, and a few laughs along the way, this episode is both a guide and a love letter to one of the world’s most captivating cities. Whether you're drawn to history, food, shopping, or simply want to experience something magical, Istanbul delivers—and this episode shows you why it belongs on every traveler’s bucket list.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol se entera en el hospital que los mareos que ha sufrido son porque est embarazada. Alejandro espera fuera de su habitaci n, pero no le dan informaci n sobre Sol. programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Yubiri pide una mesa en el medio de la pista y se sienta con Juan Diego. Pide dos cervezas. Wilker se queda helado pero se le acercan dos muchachas y le hacen compañía. Yubiri lo ve con algo de rabia. Carolina le hace caso a su abuela y se va a buscar a Juan Diego. Llega Briggite y trata de impedir que salga pero Carolina no le hace caso y se va. Briggite le pregunta a Dionisia y esta no contesta. Yubiri se disgusta cuando ve al Wilker bailando y no le pone atención a lo que le dice Juan Diego.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Wilker acompaña a Yubiri después del plantón de Juan Diego. Cuando llegan él la va a besar y ella se deja pero él al momento de hacerlo | se retira y se pone a reír. Ella le dice que no le hable más nunca. Atanasio despide a Graciela y le paga. Ella le ofrece otros servicios pero él no acepta. Briggite se queda dormida en el sofá. Junior se acerca y la besa. Ella despierta y él le dice que estaba roncando. Por fin llega Carolina y se extraña de verlo ahí. Wilker llega a su casa comiendo.

programme.title: Episodio 18
programme.desc: Yubiri piensa que Wilker la está persiguiendo. El le dice que si no será ella la que lo está persiguiendo a él. Carolina convence a Juan Diego que vaya a hablar con Briggite para que le diga que lo de ellos va en serio. Juan Diego se pone a pensar que él en ningún momento ha pensado que eso vaya en serio Briggie le pregunta a Dionisia si después de vivir tantos años con un hombre no se le habrá pegado algo del Junior. Dionisia le dice que como se le ocurre pensar eso siendo ella trabajadora.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Briggite está muy nerviosa porque hoy tiene que hacer la campaña de farmacias delante del cliente. Comienzan a hablar con Carolina y Juan Diego y ella les informa que muy pronto comenzarán a repartir las invitaciones a su matrimonio Jesica consigue al Junior en el centro. Y le cuenta que va a resolver un problema de Olegario. Jesica le recuerda que en la noche es la cena con su Papá. Briggite le dice a Finita que ese ramo de flores se llama cuernos. Finita les dice que son unas envidiosas.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Yubiri en forma muy sentida le dice a Briggite que era su Dios pero que ahora no quiere verla porque ella nunca quisiera ser una mentirosa y menos aún una ladrona Atanasio quiere homenajear a Briggite pero tiene miedo por Gisela. Armando le dice que haga una fiesta colectiva. Yubiri está esperando que Briggite le diga algo pero esta se quedó muda. Briggite le tira la toalla a la cara y se va. programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Carlos Ernesto sigue hospitalizado mientras Leo y su padre se reconcilian. Llega Julio y hay una evidente tensión entre los hermanos. Virginia le confiesa a Felipe el contenido de las cartas de Miguel Ferrándiz: habría un hijo de Rebeca que no es hijo de Leonardo. Oriana recibe el sobre del test de embarazo de manos de Alejandra y Maribel le cuenta a Irene que la licenciada está ayudando a la chica. Luego, Irene y Maribel la confrontan y se da una pelea que Rodrigo llega a detener. Jimena se guarda la tablet robada por Agustina. En la clínica, Leo y Julio se la encuentran y la interrogan. Ella pone excusas y finalmente le pide a Juan Pablo que trate de acceder al contenido. María Lucía le confiesa a Virginia que está enamorada de Leo.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo y su hijo aclaran la cuestión del origen del rumor sobre su relación con Alejandra. Mientras tanto, Adolfo busca desesperadamente su tablet, primero exigiéndole respuestas a Tony y luego aventurándose a la mansión Ferrándiz para interrogar a Agustina. Martín, el asistente de Felipe, se compromete con Rodrigo a conseguirle los documentos secretos de Miguel Ferrándiz. Juan Pablo logra acceder a los datos en el tablet de Adolfo y lo comenta con Jimena. Ambos quedan de mantener el secreto y, ante la requisitoria de Leonardo que los encuentra en plena charla, inventan cualquier excusa. Maribel y Tony hablan, y él está a punto de confesarle los motivos de la presión de Alejandra sobre él cuando Adolfo los interrumpe.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Rodrigo sigue encerrado con Irene en el ascensor y continúa con su macabro juego de insinuaciones y sugerencias para desestabilizarla. Toda la familia busca desesperadamente a Irene. Leonardo la llama sin cesar y no logra comunicarse. Lo propio ocurre con sus hermanas y su madre. Agustina le sugiere a Trinidad que Irene se fue en una aventura amorosa. Finalmente, Irene aparece y todo se tranquiliza momentáneamente. Juan Pablo convoca a Julián Zamora a una reunión para sonsacarle una confesión sobre su alianza con Casares y Rodrigo. Pero falla. Irene confronta a Agustina al volver a su casa y la amenaza con hacerla expulsar de la misma. Agustina habla con el retrato de Rebeca y parece adoptar una doble personalidad. Maribel amenaza a Tony con acusarlo de trabajar para Alejandra.

programme.title: The Smurfs

programme.title: The Smurfs

At least this is what Handy feels when he resolves to leave the Smurfs Village forever and live in the sea with Marina the Mermaid...

programme.title: Farmer's Genie

But when Farmer Smurf pulls the gourd out of the ground he frees a genie, which calls him Master and insists on granting him wishes. The genie, called Gourdy, is going to be more of a hindrance than a help in his eagerness to please Farmer Smurf.

programme.title: Poet's Writers' Block
programme.desc: The Smurfs want a poem written for each of them. The pressure overwhelms Poet, so he runs away seeking inspiration. The Wilybeast King captures Poet and forces him to write a poem to cheer up the King's daughter. Poet learns that motivation must come from the heart and cannot be forced.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Harmony Smurf is no longer wanted in the Smurf Choir: his singing is too far off-key. But Papa Smurf gives him an amulet that will make him a vocal virtuoso. Now here comes Hogatha...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Thinking Baby Smurf is a leprechaun, two poachers kidnap him and try to get the small one to tell them where his pot of gold is hidden. Papa Smurf organizes everyone to attack the villains with Smurfberry pies so Baby can escape.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: None of the Smurfs seem to have time to play with the Smurflings. And then an accident occurs, with untimely consequences...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Selwyn and Tallulah are two powerful married wizards. The trouble is, they fight all the time. But the energy from their arguments is brewing up a dreadful storm and Papa has to get them to make up before the storm starts to rage.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Balthazar brings Denisa to Gargamel to baby-sit. But Gargamel loses Denisa in the wood and she and Sassette meet and become friends. Sassette and Denisa work together to free the Smurfs from Gargamel's stewpot, and prove you don't have to be big to be brave.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Peewit, the court jester, is the Smurfs' human friend. There is to be a celebration at the King's castle and Peewit good-humouredly invites his little blue friends to the feast. But they learn that the wicked chamberlain is pilfering the King's possessions.

programme.title: The Smurfiest Of Friends
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf had one friend: Clumsy Smurf. But poor Clumsy is so, well, clumsy, that Brainy refuses to see him again. So now he is left without anyone willing to listen to him. Maybe Buddy, the good-looking imp met by chance near the Great Oak can be a pal for Brainy....

programme.title: The Smurfs

programme.title: The Smurfs

Fortunately, Bullrush is in a playful mood and devises a Smurf hunt. Unfortunately, Brainy believes he is a born leader...

programme.title: Germany's Mystic Forest
programme.desc: 2.000 rivers and streams dig deep into the underground and transport their water into reservoirs or "Germany's Wild Amazon", the Wupper. These forests and rivers, together with heathlands and moors, are home to a diverse fauna. Martens, badgers, wild boars, hares, roe deer, and red deer, even black grouse and hazel deer find shelter in these parts. Wolves also have a dominant presence, not to mention those who live underground, such as lizards, bats, and snakes. Accompany us on a journey where we explore every corner of this rugged land. Climb underground into the Bergisches Land, through the vast hidden cave systems that sprawl far beneath the forests. There is also much to be discovered in the water, dive with us in crystal clear streams and rivers with their diverse flora and fauna.

programme.title: Wild & Wide Awake - From the Mediterranean to the Alps
programme.desc: The first part of the spring journey takes us from the Spanish inland to the rugged Atlantic and to the Mediterranean, through the French Provence, and finally into the Alps. Along the way, flamingos perform their bizarre dancing rituals, wild horses storm through the wetland… While the North is still covered by snow and ice, the South will soon turn into a blooming garden and every creature is enjoying the first signs of the awakening.

programme.title: World's Most Dangerous Railway Lines
programme.desc: The Ferrocarril del Sur, one of the highest train routes on earth, runs right through the mountains of Peru. To this day, it is considered a miracle in the world of railways. The rails not only lead to the famous ruined city of Machu Picchu but connect the ancient Inca capital of Cusco with Puno on the shores of Lake Titicaca and the gleaming white city of Arequipa. A train journey with the Andes Explorer through a grandiose landscape and an undeveloped and inaccessible area.

programme.title: World's Most Dangerous Railway Lines
programme.desc: In northern Argentina, the world-famous Tren a las Nubes - the cloud train - crosses dizzying viaducts and deep valleys. At an altitude of over 4000 meters, what was once the highest railway runs past cactus forests and into the driest desert in the world. A technical feat in the Andes and a breathtaking ride through spectacular scenery.In northern Argentina, the world-famous Tren a las Nubes - the cloud train - crosses dizzying viaducts and deep valleys. At an altitude of over 4000 meters, what was once the highest railway runs past cactus forests and into the driest desert in the world. A technical feat in the Andes and a breathtaking ride through spectacular scenery.

programme.title: The Last Paradises: Breath of the Arctic - Wilderness North
programme.desc: This foray through northern realms of our planet above the polar circle takes us to a part of our world especially affected by climate change. The often-cited adaptability of animals could also enable them to survive under new conditions. The camera team made this foray through the polar region, from Canada to Norway, to document that, which in the opinion of many nature researchers, will no longer be visible in 30 to 50 years' time. Following the observation of ice bear mother with her young in Canada's Wapusk National Park at Hudson Bay, is a herd of harp seals on the ice during the breeding season. The Arctic Ocean ringed seals in Hudson Bay, on the other hand, prefer solitude. Should the offspring be born in an extremely cold night, they often freeze to death. Their bodies sink to the seabed at the beginning of spring when the pack ice thaws. Scavengers like the rare Greenland shark, who sees them as a welcome snack, quickly eats them. Underwater footage of this process also attempted by our camera team, very rarely succeeds.

programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: Iceland - On Top of the World
programme.desc: A scenic expedition through majestic volcanoes, seething geysers, powerful waterfalls, threatening fjords and almighty glaciers. Hardly any other country offers such a variety of spectacular forces of nature! We will give you an insight on how it can be that the people of a small, distant island with only a fraction of sunlight in some months are happier than the people in more sun-blessed countries.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: Rugged coasts, untouched nature and the rough climate of the Atlantic characterize the landscape on the west coast of Scotland. In the sounds and lochs of the Scottish West, "Waverley", the last seaworthy passenger steamship in the world, appears once a year. The side-wheel steamer was built in 1947 to carry out short ferry passages on the Clyde River. Today, "Waverley" circumnavigates almost all of Great Britain. The impressive ship was sold to the "Paddle Steamer Preservation Society" in 1974 for the symbolic price of one English pound. Since then, she starts her season off the Western Isles in Scotland every year in May.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: The paddle steamer "Skibladner" is the oldest passenger paddle steamer in the world in regular service. It has been plying Norway's largest inland lake, the Mjøsa, since 1856. The "white swan" has a melodious name, borrowed from Norse mythology. The ship "Skíðblaðnir" of the god Freyr, built by dwarves, could always have a tail wind, could be stowed in a small bag when folded and all gods in armor had room on it. The traditional ship of AS Oplandandske Dampskibsselskap does not have such fairy-tale powers, but atmospherically the "Skibladner" also transports guests to a world long gone.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: Idlewild - Avalon - Belle of Louisville - these three names stand for the last still roadworthy, historic sternwheeler in the USA. In 1914, the ship was built as "Idlewild" for the West Memphis Packet Company as a passenger ferry. With a draft of only 1.50 m and a robust steel hull, the boat is suitable for almost all navigable rivers of the Mississippi River system. Today, the "Belle" is the most traveled steamboat in American history. In the course of her eventful life, she has called at 130 places in 19 states.

programme.title: mareTV: Hong Kong - Metropolis in the sea
programme.desc: Hong Kong translated means "fragrant harbour". The days of the spicy smoking ceremonies have passed, but MareTV has discovered many delightful contrasts between the metropolis and Mother Nature. In for-mer times, the rare eagle wood tree grew here. Its wood put the spice into the Taoist smoking ceremonies. The fragrant harbour: what sounds so charming is today a huge metropolis in the sea. No other tiny piece of land is more densely populated. Star Ferries have been commuting between the Kowloon Peninsula and central Hong Kong for the past 125 years. The British colonial masters are long gone, but on the ancient ferries, virtually nothing has changed. Most of the ships are still clad in British Racing Green and the crew still wears the old, decorative uniforms.

programme.title: Moon, The: Our Gateway To The Universe
programme.desc: We are on the verge of a new age of exploration: besides the plans of NASA and other space agencies, over the next years also privately financed teams are going to send unmanned vehicles to the Moon. The goal is to find a cheap and efficient way to travel there on a regular basis, and in the long term to build a permanent human base.

programme.title: Predators of a Different Kind - In the World of the Unknown Sharks
programme.desc: With the aid of modern technology, reveal the unknown behaviour of some unusual species of shark: lemon sharks and their white-tip reef counterparts. Our film trip begins on the Bahamas. To be more precise: in the turquoise-blue waters of the Grand Bahama Bank, in an exactly fixed location. In the spring, 70 – 80 pregnant lemon sharks arrive here. This huge shark population was first discovered just a few years ago by shark researcher, Professor Sam Gruber. Many of the females are tired and rest on the seabed. Pregnant tiger sharks swim in the midst of this group. Without any protection whatsoever, our cameramen shoot their footage, surrounded by sharks and succeed in capturing images hitherto unseen. We continue our journey to Gainesville, Florida, to meet Gordon Hubbell, the leading shark denture expert with the world’s largest shark denture collection. He knows everything about the evolutionary history of the lemon sharks, in addition to those of the white-tip reef variety off Cocos Island, Costa Rica. Here, we encounter large schools of fish, unprecedented numbers of stingrays, as well as hammerhead sharks. However, it is the white-tip reek sharks that make the biggest impression. Their performance begins late at night. Marauding, they patrol in large groups through the reefs and hunt everything that moves. Scales and dead prey fish float above the reef – a welcoming change of diet for the ubiquitous barracudas.

programme.title: Wild Moments
programme.desc: Wildlife film-makers often risk life and limb trying to capture unique images of their dangerous protagonists. In Alaska a cunning grizzly threatens the son of Andreas Kieling, on the remote Wrangel Island in northern-east Siberia his colleague Uwe Anders is taken by surprise by a a polar bear, and off the coast of South Africa a diving-team is unexpectedly surrounded by white sharks. But the life of the film-makers is also threatened by elemental forces, life-threatening diseases and failing technical equipment: Deep in the vast rainforests of West Africa cameraman Klaus Scheurich nearly dies of malaria, and in South India a film team narrowly escapes death in a hot-air balloon accident. But they also meet remarkable people such as a zoo keeper in Cameroon who feels at ease playing with half-grown and adult gorillas - the most powerful of all great apes. The first episode "Wild Moments - Dangerous and Deadly" follows wildlife film-makers on their adventurous journeys throughout the world.

programme.title: Wild Moments
programme.desc: Wildlife filmmakers often risk life and limb trying to capture unique images of their dangerous protagonists. A cunning grizzly grabs a salmon off Andreas Kieling's fishing rod, in the depths of the Amazon River a diving team has a spooky encounter with piranhas, in the Mediterranean Sea the currents nearly push Thomas Behrend into the mouths of angry sperm whales defending a newborn - and cameramen who want to film jaguars in the dense jungle of South America become easy prey for the well camouflaged cats. The life of the film-makers is also threatened by elemental forces and failing technical equipment: In the swamps of North Australia violent storms hold up the crossing of tearing rivers, a volcano in the South Seas spits burning lumps of lava into the base camp, and in Siberia a camera team breaks through the ice and has to camp at minus 30°C in the middle of nowhere. The second episode "Wild Moments - Dangerous and Deadly" follows wildlife-filmmakers on their adventurous journeys throughout the world.

programme.title: Wild Moments
programme.desc: Wildlife filmmakers often risk life and limb trying to capture unique images of their dangerous protagonists. In the Kruger National Park Josef Jozefowicz steps into a lionesses' den to film her cubs, in Alaska Andreas Kieling mingles with giant elk bulls in order to film them in action, and in Florida his colleague Zoltan Török gets very close to an alligator mother guarding its nest. The life of the film-makers is also threatened by elemental forces, and failing technical equipment: the strong and tearing current of the Yukon River throws Andreas Kieling's boat onto a gravel bank, in the Democratic Republik of Congo camerawoman Heike Grebe is separated from her colleagues in the dense rainforest, in Kamchatka a film team only just escapes a gigantic landslide, and in Finland a hot-air balloon catches fire and becomes the nightmare of Oliver Goetzl and Ivo Nörenberg. The last episode "Wild Moments - Dangerous and Deadly" follows wildlife film-makers on their adventurous journeys throughout the world.

programme.title: mareTV: Denmarks Limfjord - From Sea to Sea
programme.desc: Wide open spaces, water, meadows: The Limfjord stretches through Jutland in Denmark in countless bays, canals and sounds. Mighty water castles, country palaces and magnificent monasteries are enthroned on its shores. It is a rather lonely area, even in high summer it is quiet. This is probably why the people here are so friendly and sociable. Birte, Silla and Bo cycle to their fjord garden project in the harbor of the town of Løgstør to harvest mussels, oysters and seaweed. They think gardening is best in a club. Luckily, Silla, a resourceful tinkerer, has just made another ingenious invention: the mussel washing machine. Cruising the narrow Næssund, a branch of the Limfjord, is the Næssund Ferry, the smallest and oldest car ferry in the area. New on board, and the first and only woman on this ship, is deckhand Lilian Kohler. She is "girl for everything", but wants more, because Lilian is a trained navigator. She is magically drawn to the bridge, but the old captain doesn't think much of retiring ashore.

programme.title: mareTV: The white wilderness in Greenland's East
programme.desc: Fjords, glaciers and the highest mountains in the Arctic: East Greenland with its spectacular nature is one of the most sparsely populated regions on earth. The people here live in extreme isolation and depend on helicopter flights for their supplies. Despite harsh conditions, the inhabitants here lovingly maintain their traditions and enjoy their outdoor leisure time even at minus 20 degrees Celsius. The town of Tasiilaq is the "metropolis" with 4,000 inhabitants and offers a very special attraction: the only ski lift on the east coast. Thomas Mikaelsen, the lift attendant, is not to be envied for his job. The only 100 meter long lift comes from Switzerland and is already 20 years old. If Thomas gets the drag lift running at all, it often only lasts for an hour. Then the ski crazy's luck depends on his repair skills. The lift is the only frosty open-air pleasure. For Salo Kunuk his sled dogs are both pleasure and work. He is currently teaching his daughter Karla how to steer a dog sled, private driving lessons from her father, so to speak. Karla will need it, because in the eternal ice the sled is the only means of transportation.

programme.title: The Last Paradises: Patagonia - Coast of the Killer Whale
programme.desc: On the wild coast of Patagonia, the nature calendar describes the most diverse visiting times of fascinating animals, from the southern right whale and other large whales, via the sea lions and elephant seals up to the orcas and millions of penguins. The encounters with whales and their babies are spectacular. Hardly anywhere else on earth can one experience both the brutal and the delightful sides of nature so vividly and so close. The trip to the hot spots for animal watchers and researchers leads us inter alia to the Caleta Valdez. This is where, during the mating season, the southern elephant seals bring their babies into the world, mate and enjoy a little sunbathing on the beach.

programme.title: Over the Islands of Africa
programme.desc: Photographer Matthias Ziegler is an Africa specialist. He has visited nearly every country on the continent on assignments for international agencies. Zanzibar, however, is new territory for him. He's come to the former slave island for a photo book – and this time he's not alone. To see the Tanzanian archipelago from the air, he has enlisted the services of ultralight pilot Richard Meredith-Hardy of England to fly him around in his FIB, or flying inflatable boat. Perfect conditions for an adventurous journey: as a world champion ultralight pilot, Richard and his FIB can take off and land practically anywhere – in theory.

programme.title: Over the Islands of Africa
programme.desc: Renaud Van Der Meeren is a photographer and paramotor pilot. With his motorised parachute he goes on expeditions to the remotest corners on earth to photograph people and landscapes from the air. Renaud wanted to be a jet pilot, studied music at the Sorbonne, became a ski instructor, model and photographer's assistant before he found happiness in his current vocation. He especially likes to do his job in Mauritius – nowhere else does he find so many motifs as on the "sweetest pearl in the Indian Ocean". This time he's working on a photo book about Mauritius – by land, by water and in the air.

programme.title: Over the Islands of Africa
programme.desc: Spirits, Kings, Lemurs – Madagascar treats Ami to a multitude of new impressions and spectacular pictures. Director Christian Schidlowski and his team accompanied her on her trip.

programme.title: In the Heart of Scotland - By Train trough the Lowlands
programme.desc: The first part of this journey through Scotland begins in the colourful and vibrant capital, Edinburgh. It takes us through the rolling hills of the Scottish Lowlands, en route to the wild, picturesque east coast and Aberdeen. There are new and exciting views behind every bend: heath-covered hills with a magically purple glow, beautiful lakes and forests of the deepest shades of green. The breath-taking camerawork for this documentary received the Columbus Film Award.

programme.title: mareTV: Scotland's Mild West - On The Inner Hebrides
programme.desc: The Inner Hebrides surprise with green hills, fine sandy beaches and a mild climate, at least as far as Scottish conditions allow. This is ensured by the currents of the Gulf Stream, as well as the Scottish archipelago being protected by its sister islands, which belong to the Outer Hebrides. More than half of the almost 80 islands are uninhabited. Loneliness has made the people rather inventive. On Tiree Island, mathematics, history and physics from the mainland arrive in the classroom per mouseclick. Dr Mauvis Gore and Prof. Rupert Ormond cast off from the island of Mull, after setting a course to encounter a basking shark. The cetohinus maximus is the world's second largest fish and the two scientists are absolutely convinced that the waters surrounding the Mull constitute the mating grounds for the basking sharks. A logistical challenge takes place on the Isle of Easdale each September. Then, around 400 people populate the tiny slate island. Donals "Mellon" Melville organises the World Skimming Championships, a World Cup in jumping stones. This is all about the distance they are thrown and they must only hop above the water twice.

programme.title: Poppy's Promise - Secret Life in a Cornfield
programme.desc: The cornfield - just an area for producing food… or a land full of secrets? This doc portrays a little recognized habitat right next door. The spectacular visuals filmed with state of the art equipment introduce the surprisingly large diversity of field inhabitants. We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about. In the western industrial nations cornfields and woods take up the greatest proportion of rural land. But how much natural life dwells in a cornfield? Why are some cornfield inhabitants harmful and others useful and what do the colourful flowers at the edge of the field promise us? We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about.

programme.title: Marcus Holman and the Moment He Became Obsessed with Lacrosse
programme.desc: Kyle Harrison sits down with Marcus Holman - one of lacrosse’s greatest shooters and leaders - for an honest conversation about family, obsession, adversity, longevity, and chasing the all-time goals record. Marcus takes us back to his earliest memories from John's Hopkins’ locker room to the moment he fell in love with shooting He opens up about evolving his role, becoming a leader, sustaining greatness into his mid-30s, and what it would mean to cement his legacy in the record books.

programme.title: Behind The Draw
programme.desc: Ty’s passion for the outdoors has certainly transcended to the next generation and his kids can’t get enough! Hunter and Alexa both tagged mature bucks with one being a very typical and the other a wild nontypical in this family episode!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Slade and the crew are finally able to catch up with these elk despite some pretty terrible weather conditions. It comes right down to the wire! Don’t miss it.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Episode 2 of Hunting Land Man keeps it rolling in the Mississippi woods. We’ve got some good buddies in camp this week, and it doesn’t take long for things to get interesting. One hunt ends in a tough miss, but we stay after it and bounce back with a longbeard hitting the dirt not long after. Later in the week, Slade’s wife Lori gets her first turkey of the year in an awesome hunt that came together just right. That’s just how it goes, what turkey hunting is all about, some ups, some downs, and a whole lot of good times. Season 4 is heating up.

programme.title: Shoshone Adventures
programme.desc: Join Shoshone Team Members Sam Kohler & David McElwain embark on an epic mountain hunting expedition to Kodiak Island, Alaska in pursuit of the majestic Mountain Goat and famed Sitka Blacktail Deer. This hunt is an expose on the trials and tribulations of mountain hunting and the brotherhood that is forged in the untamed wilderness of Kodiak.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his son, Logan visit the beautiful country of New Zealand. From visiting Vineyards and sampling wine, to helicopter hunts for Himalayan Tahr, this episode is everything that is a hunters dream. As well as harvesting the wild game New Zealand has to offer Andy also learns about the importance of the conservation efforts that hunting has in this country from locals in which he spends time with.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his friend Scotty take on Kodiak Island, Alaska for an adventure of Salmon fishing and hunting black tail deer. Whilst traversing steep mountains in the company of Kodiak brown bears and taking on cold Alaskan waters, Andy presents useful information for fellow outdoor enthusiasts all whilst building friendships with the great people of Kodiak Big Timber Lodge.

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: For decades, Paul Butski has set the standard in turkey calling. His name is etched into the NWTF Grand National Calling Championships Hall of Fame, and his influence stretches far beyond the stage. He didn’t just win competitions, he shaped the way we talk to turkeys – and more importantly, the way we hunt them.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Join WoodHaven's Mike Pentecost as he kicks off his Alabama turkey season - these mountain birds are tough to hunt!

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: WoodHaven’s Josh Anderson heads to the Western Plains of Kansas in pursuit of a mature whitetail buck. Because of the wide open terrain, a decoy and blind calling can be very affective because of the visibility. After a few well-timed grunts on the Intimidator grunt call, a shooter buck shows up right at the base of the tree!

programme.title: Pure Hunting
programme.desc: Willi and Chris are back in New Mexico, bowhunting elk. Willi made a poor shot on a bull, and after discovering the cause of the poor shot, he hopes to get redemption as their hunting days come to a close.

programme.title: Pure Hunting
programme.desc: Willi and Chris have hunted NM for years with some success each year. This year they included two new friends, Nick Ventura and his dad. Willi had some success mid-hunt and with the clock winding down on the last evening, would the far off bugle produce a bull for Chris?

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: Human encroachment and pressure from poaching are the greatest threats to wildlife in Africa. Dan Cabela has traveled to Tanzania to see how Robin Hurt safaris manages two large conservation areas in the face of these daily challenges.

programme.title: Spring Thunder
programme.desc: We were honored to be a part of the Gold Star Youth Outdoors Turkey Hunt at Iron Horse Farms in Alabama. Cole Barthel and Bryan Brown were able to get Charlie Willington his first turkey. Be sure to check out Gold Star Youth Outdoors and Iron Horse Farms.

programme.title: Spring Thunder
programme.desc: Low turkey population densities and the rocky, steep terrain of New York State's Adirondack Mountains create a unique spring turkey hunting challenge only found in this region of the country. It's not always easy to find wild turkeys here, but when you can, there is always the chance that this bird has never been hunted making success particularly special.

programme.title: Spring Thunder
programme.desc: Second leg in the slam is complete! Justin Webb killed his Rio in Texas. - Next stop - Tennessee for the Eastern.

programme.title: Spring Thunder
programme.desc: Roger Culpepper takes Sophia Mahlke and her dad Tom to kill her first longbeard. The guys and girl find the gobblers on roost in a beautiful Georgia hardwood bottom and make their move.

programme.title: Spring Thunder
programme.desc: Realtree's David Blanton heads south of the border to hunt the Gould's turkey with Jay Scott Outdoors. - For more info on hunting with Jay Scott Outdoors: visit www.gouldsturkeyhunt.com

programme.title: Spring Thunder
programme.desc: David Blanton has a gobbler in his lap right off the Roost in Kansas hunting with JB Outfitters.

programme.title: Spring Thunder
programme.desc: The Spring Thunder crew teams up with the guys from Hunt Club and Realtree Roadtrips to take a group of veterans on a life changing turkey hunt at Redstone Arsenal in Huntsville, AL.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: The boys are in Missouri at the Raven and they are ready to burn some powder and get rifle season kicked off at the Raven.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: Bow season is finally here and the boys are at the Dirty Bird in Oklahoma. Randy is chasing a buck he named "The Camp Buck" because of how close the buck is to camp. If Randy can get it done this will be his biggest buck to date in Oklahoma.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: The boys are on the Raven in Missouri trying to plant 50 acres of Big Tine food plots in 5 days before heading out west to kick off the hunting season.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: The boys are at the Dirty Bird in Oklahoma trying to run some trot lines on the North Canadian river but the water is just a little lower than they expected.

programme.title: Captain's Log

programme.title: Saltwater Experience

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor catch two thirds of a slam when they bring Tom’s new Yellowfin 24’ Bay up to Key Largo for some exciting flats fishing.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor are joined by Captain Mason Baker to sample some early morning Islamorada backcountry baby tarpon action.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: After a successful morning of baby tarpon fishing, Captains Tom Rowland, Rich Tudor and Mason Baker slide over to the legendary downtown Islamorada flats to check on the resurgence of Florida Keys bonefish.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor head into the Everglades backcountry out of Key Largo to fish the shallow grass flats for tailing redfish.

programme.title: Reel Animals

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: Capt. Josh heads offshore with Marcus Castro for a day of fishing, hoping to reel in the perfect catch for tonight’s family dinner.

programme.title: Fox Hollow Outdoors
programme.desc: Michael continues the family tradition of fish stew and gathering, with hopes that Larkin will pass on the same traditions.

programme.title: Fox Hollow Outdoors
programme.desc: Michael and Larken head to South Texas in search of trophy-sized trout. Along the way they make a pitstop to gear up and custom-build a Texas wading rod.

programme.title: Silver Kings
programme.desc: Capt. Jared Raskob joins Key West Guide Capt. Nick LaBadie on a quest for a Keys Grand Slam.

programme.title: Local Lines
programme.desc: In Today's episode, Brandon is going to be fishing with Larry from Save Crystal River. They will be targeting Redfish, Trout, and Bass.

programme.title: Flats Class
programme.desc: CA returns to his old stomping grounds, chasing legend in familiar waters. Giants still roam here and feed on the smallest of offerings.

programme.title: Captain's Log

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: When Justin and Meredith stay positive after a series of bad breaks, it pays off in fun. If fun means fish. After all, we are in Panama City Beach.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: Florida WaterSports Jeff Lange & Capt Justin head out of PCB in the wee morning hours hoping to land a limit of tasty table fare before the window of opportunity closes. Pro tip: Electric reels save shoulders.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Each year we get to spend time in camp with some of our best friends. Zach from Big & J gets some time in a blind while reflecting on what hunting in Texas means to him. programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: This is the story of how FE Hill ranch got it's start. From its inception, FE Hill has created opportunities for people to experience the outdoors and create memories. For us, it has created a tradition of Fathers and Sons hunting together.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: With bucks on their feet and chasing does, Dan puts his skills and his muzzleloader to the test, hoping to connect with a true Sooner State giant.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Col. Nick Nichols from Folds of Honor and Olympic skeet shooter Dania Vizzi are both proud Americans who have represented their country overseas. Col. Nichols commanded the air in the cockpit of a fighter jet for countless missions during his seven combat tours and Dania donned the stars and bars proudly on her shooting vest as an Olympian in Paris. Now with Winchesters in hand, both are in the Midwest whitetail woods during late November during the back end of the rut hoping to connect on a Missouri monarch.

programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor are joined by Rich's son Reed, who takes the wheel and directs the team into some amazing early morning baby tarpon fishing in the Everglades.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor take Hunter Smallback into the Everglades for some snook fishing, and the action really heats up when some hungry Lemon sharks crash the party.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor catch two thirds of a slam when they bring Tom’s new Yellowfin 24’ Bay up to Key Largo for some exciting flats fishing.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor are joined by Captain Mason Baker to sample some early morning Islamorada backcountry baby tarpon action.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: After a successful morning of baby tarpon fishing, Captains Tom Rowland, Rich Tudor and Mason Baker slide over to the legendary downtown Islamorada flats to check on the resurgence of Florida Keys bonefish.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor head into the Everglades backcountry out of Key Largo to fish the shallow grass flats for tailing redfish.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors
programme.desc: Capt. Blair has some down time in Alaska, so what does he do? Heads to the beach to check out the salmon hatchery in Ketchican. They've met their quota for the year so the season is open, but the trick is how to catch the salmon. There hasn't been an episode like this yet.

programme.title: We Caught That
programme.desc: In this episode, Capt. Jason heads out with his longtime hunting buddy to fish in Keaton Beach. Afterward, they head over to try and shoot some feral hogs on private land in North Florida.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Water quality is everything—and the Star brite - SeaSafe team is back at it for the second year in a row! Led by Cory Redwine, Conservation Director of Project SeaSafe, this is the 4th Annual Clean Water Collective and it’s bigger than ever. This time, we’re in Grant, Florida, where 4 million clams are being released into the Indian River Lagoon, paired with the planting of thousands of mangroves, oyster work by CCA and trash clean ups to help restore one of Florida’s most critical ecosystems. But it’s not just about hard work—it’s about connection. With local captains, fishing legends, and the Local Knowledge crew on hand, we hit the water to show why this place is worth fighting for. From clam drops by drone, to in-water mangrove planting, to monster snook catches, this is hands-on conservation at its best. This two-part series kicks off with action, heart, and the kind of hope only a healthy waterway can bring. Don’t miss Part 1—where conservation meets community and everyone gets their hands wet.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: As part of this year's Star brite Sea Safe event, we hit the water to experience some of the incredible fishing the Indian River Lagoon has to offer. For Rush, that meant some serious bow time with close friend Alex Hughey - on the hunt for some of the biggest snook we've ever encountered. The bite wasn't easy, but that didn't stop Rush from smashing his personal best - not once, but twice - in one unforgettable day on the water. Don't miss this action-packed episode of the Sea Safe adventure from beautiful Sebastian, Florida!

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends
programme.desc: Things get even more epic in Season 3 as Talking Tom and Friends try new ways to make their dreams come true, making more friends (and enemies) along the way!

programme.title: Monster Town
programme.desc: Meet the Monster Trucks, a gang of colossal, hard-working cars who team up to help their friends and community in Monster City.

programme.title: Ollie! The Boy Who Became What He Ate
programme.desc: Ollie is a 6-year-old with a massive imagination, often lost in his own world - flipping, sliding, climbing and rocket-blasting through the house, practicing at being the master of all things. But even masters need to stop and refuel. When meals or snack time interrupt Ollie’s play, he finds himself confronted with the real challenge of childhood; trying new food. To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

programme.title: The Fixies
programme.desc: The Fixies follows the comical misadventures of Tom Thomas and his secret friendship with Simka and Nolik, the children of the Fixie family that lives in his apartment. There’s just no end to the troubles Tom Thomas and his Fixie friends get themselves into with all the gadgets and appliances around them!

programme.title: Gummy Bear and Friends
programme.desc: Gummy lives in an apartment with his friend Harry the Chameleon, while his other friend Kala the Cat hangs out in a ninja dojo on the roof. Together they go on wild and wacky adventures in their building and hometown. Enjoy the fun and crazy adventures!

programme.title: Grojband
programme.desc: The story about 12 year old Corey that emotionally torments his sister so that she will write the ultimate lyrics for his garage band.

programme.title: Box Yourself
programme.desc: Great Projects From Ordinary Cardboard!

programme.title: Ebb and Flo
programme.desc: The world of Ebb and Flo is seen through Ebb’s eyes and Ebb reveals all the emotions grown-ups try to hide. Flo doesn’t think of Ebb as a dog, and Ebb doesn’t think of Flo as a small human, they just are the best of friends. Until Bird arrives to lovingly disrupt Ebb’s world. programme.title: Aurora Boreal (Mi Ultimo d¡a)
programme.desc: Mexico, 1994. Mariano, un adolescente atormentado, ha decidido quitarse la vida… pero no sin antes grabar un testimonio en video para explicarle al mundo las razones detrás de su decision.

programme.title: Brujas del Cordobazo
programme.desc: El Cordobazo fue una manifestacion popular que significo un impulso fundamental para la sociedad argentina

programme.title: Bruma
programme.desc: Martina queda embarazada de su novio egoista. Sin saber exactamente que hacer, viaja a Berlin para buscar a su padre, a quien nunca conocio.

programme.title: Asfixia
programme.desc: Despues de salir de prision, donde aprendio a cuidar enfermos, Alma, una mujer albina, está decidida a recuperar algo mucho más importante que su propia libertad.

programme.title: LOS ORIYINALES
programme.desc: Un antropologo argentino gracioso analiza la sociedad colombiana a traves de encuentros comicos con personajes verdaderamente “oriyinales”.

programme.title: HUNABKU
programme.desc: Federico, Mabel y su hijo Lucas dejan su vida en Buenos Aires y se mudan al sur, seducidos por una prometedora oferta de trabajo para Federico.

programme.title: JAGUAR VOZ DE UN TERRITORIO
programme.desc: Es un recorrido por montañas, selvas y llanuras donde el jaguar ha tenido una relacion directa con los seres humanos.

programme.title: JUEGOS DE LA VIDA
programme.desc: Javier, un adolescente egoista, cambia tras un accidente. Una historia de amor, amistad y reflexion sobre lo esencial de la vida.

programme.title: KIMURA
programme.desc: Armando Carrera, un exluchador con un pasado tragico, regresa a Panama en busca del perdon de su hermano Alejandro.

programme.title: LA LLEVADA Y LA TRAIDA
programme.desc: Seis personajes explican su existencia compleja e interconectada. De vez en cuando, por una matematica inexplicable, sus vidas cambian y ocupan el cuerpo de otro.

programme.title: SAN ANDRECITO
programme.desc: En Sanandresito, Bogota, el policia relajado Wilson es incriminado por un asesinato. Debe descubrir al verdadero culpable antes que su novia lo arreste y un guardaespaldas lo encuentre.

programme.title: REALIDAD TRANSFORMABLE
programme.desc: Dos historias paralelas: Mariano Oberlin, sacerdote en Cordoba, y Fabiola Soria, mAnager de boxeo en Salta, buscan la belleza en la resiliencia humana.

programme.title: QUERIDA NANCY
programme.desc: Documental sobre Nancy CArdenas, pionera del movimiento LGBT en Mexico.

programme.title: PRESOS
programme.desc: Victoria, apasionada por la danza, tiene una relacion controladora. Consigue un trabajo que la conecta con el mundo penitenciario y descubre una realidad que la obliga a replantear su libertad.

programme.title: POZOAMARGO
programme.desc: Jesus, un hombre de mediana edad, descubre que tiene una enfermedad venerea. Abandona a su esposa embarazada y huye al campo, donde conoce a Gloria.

programme.title: PORQUE DEJARON A NACHO
programme.desc: El corazon de Nacho se rompe cuando su prometida lo deja el dia de la propuesta. Intenta recuperarla, lo que lo lleva a aventuras peligrosas y comicas.

programme.title: PARAMO
programme.desc: Jesus, joven graduado en literatura y filosofia, planea suicidarse tras entregar su tesis sobre *Pedro PAramo* de Juan Rulfo.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: An alien satellite that has been “watching” us for fifty years collides with a NASA shuttle. Rinaker doesn’t want its secrets exposed, so he sends Logan, Blaze, Trueblood and Ti-Yet on a stolen Lycanthrope ship to retrieve the data before anyone else. Logan hopes the information might reveal information about his father.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Cattle mutilation draws Logan to a small town and saddles him with a new partner, Dr. Petrovic. They discover science has spawned more trouble – hybrid, mutant, alien fire ants. Now they must rescue the townsfolk and the Detail Team before Rinaker calls an air strike on the town.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Mab, Queen of the Banshees, dispatches two bullheaded Minotauri bounty hunters and a cerberus parahound after the same prize – the head of Sh’lainn Blaze.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: A vampire that once worked for INTRAcom has mutated and is now staging attacks on his former boss’s holdings in an effort to protect the Brazilian rain forest. The creature rescues Logan, but Rinaker calls for an air strike on a lost Vampire city rather than risk its discovery by INTRAcom.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Sh’lainn’s death vision predicts everyone at the Alliance base will die in twelve hours. What she doesn’t realize is that she will be the cause. After coming into contact with a recovered alien probe, she reverts to her wildest Banshee state and begins mutating the technology around her. Magical “earth stones” from the Banshee clan may be her only hope.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Logan and Fitz are missing and presumed dead while on a mission to locate a downed alien ship in Haiti. They have been captured by a race of slug-like beings that can only inhabit the bodies of dead humans, which transforms them into zombies. Logan and Fitz are next and time is running out.

programme.title: Dork Hunters and The Pirates of Tortuga Island
programme.desc: The Dork Hunters visit tropical Tortuga Island on their summer vacation, unaware that the Dork Commander and his second-in-command are at the same resort in search of a buried treasure chest full of micro-galaxies

programme.title: Highlander: The Animated Series
programme.desc: A flashback shows the death of Connor MacLeod at Kortan's hand during the Jettator ceremony.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When an Alliance raid on a Banshee clan permits the escape of Banshee renegade, Sh’lainn Blaze, the Alliance turns to professional bounty hunter Nick Logan for help. Logan’s investigation turns up questions about his own past life – even as the vengeful Banshee try to eliminate both Logan and his quarry.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Rinaker wants Nick and Sh’lainn eliminated because he’s afraid they know too much about the Alliance. The renegade bounty hunter and Banshee track an Alliance airship to its secret Roswell base. Logan is ready to turn himself in to get some answers, but the Banshee grab Sh’lainn and Logan must turn to the Alliance for help with her rescue.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: On their first Alliance assignment, Nick and Sh’lainn are sent by Rinaker to the Himalayas to find a missing team of mountain climbers. They find the alien refugees – the Yeti – who are guarding a stolen Lycanthrope weapon powerful enough to destroy the planet. All are in danger, as the werewolves will stop at nothing to get the weapon back in their possession.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: In his relentless search to find out what truly happened to his biological father, Logan uncovers something he didn’t bargain for – an assassin android that marches right up to the Alliance’s front door looking for its preprogrammed target – Nick Logan!

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When a team of allied intelligence agents learns that extraterrestrial beings have been living among humans for years, they vow to protect earth.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Ruck, the werewolves pack leader, escapes from the Alliance and tracks down the EMP bomb which the Yeti race has been hiding. The doomsday device is accidentally activated while it’s being stolen, and Logan must discover its location before time runs out.
